mapper.sql: select c.chat_id, c.buyer_id, c.seller_id, c.store_id, c.order_id, c.message_type, c.content, c.sender_type, c.sender_id, c.is_read, c.create_time, c.update_time, u1.nick_name as buyer_name, u2.nick_name as seller_name, s.store_name from shop_chat c left join sys_user u1 on c.buyer_id = u1.user_id left join sys_user u2 on c.seller_id = u2.user_id left join shop_store s on c.store_id = s.store_id
mapper.select: select c.seller_id, c.store_id, u2.nick_name as seller_name, s.store_name, max(c.create_time) as create_time, (select count(*) from shop_chat where buyer_id = #{buyerId} and seller_id = c.seller_id and store_id = c.store_id and is_read = '0' and sender_type = '1' and del_flag = '0') as unread_count from shop_chat c left join sys_user u2 on c.seller_id = u2.user_id left join shop_store s on c.store_id = s.store_id and s.del_flag = '0' where c.buyer_id = #{buyerId} and c.del_flag = '0' group by c.seller_id, c.store_id, u2.nick_name, s.store_name order by max(c.create_time) desc

select c.buyer_id, c.seller_id, c.store_id, u1.nick_name as buyer_name, s.store_name, max(c.create_time) as create_time, (select count(*) from shop_chat where seller_id = #{sellerId} and buyer_id = c.buyer_id and store_id = c.store_id and is_read = '0' and sender_type = '0' and del_flag = '0') as unread_count from shop_chat c left join sys_user u1 on c.buyer_id = u1.user_id left join shop_store s on c.store_id = s.store_id and s.del_flag = '0' where c.seller_id = #{sellerId} and c.del_flag = '0' group by c.buyer_id, c.seller_id, c.store_id, u1.nick_name, s.store_name order by max(c.create_time) desc

select count(*) from shop_chat where del_flag = '0' and is_read = '0'
and buyer_id = #{userId} and sender_type = '1'
and seller_id = #{userId} and sender_type = '0'
